bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 自 30 日均线附近反弹

read.en: AMD rose 1.9% on Oct 13 to $605.53 after dipping to $570.60 intraday, close to its 30-day average ($568.6). It sits below its 5-day ($614.9) and 10-day ($621.7) averages, both now turning lower, and above the 30, 100 ($523.3) and 200-day ($389.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 but is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($651), and RSI is 56.
read.zh: AMD 10月13日盘中一度跌至 $570.60，接近 30 日均线（$568.6），随后反弹，收涨 1.9% 至 $605.53。股价位于 5 日（$614.9）和 10 日均线（$621.7）下方，两者均已拐头向下，并位于 30 日、100 日（$523.3）和 200 日均线（$389.2）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$651），RSI 为 56。

read.en: The $588 pivot was pierced intraday but held on a closing basis, and the rebound came off the 30-day zone. Resistance is $615–622 (5 and 10-day averages), then $648 (Oct 6–7 closes) and the $658.5 record. Support is $588, then $569–571 (30-day average and Oct 13 low) and $525 (August pivot). A close above $622 would put $648 back in view.
read.zh: $588 转折点盘中被跌破，但收盘守住，反弹始于 30 日均线区域。阻力为 $615–622（5 日和 10 日均线），其次 $648（10月6–7日收盘价）及 $658.5 纪录高点。支撑为 $588，其次 $569–571（30 日均线及 10月13日低点）和 $525（8月转折点）。若收盘站上 $622，$648 将重回视野。
